findings.message: `*.png` ignores every PNG, including the README banner `assets/social-preview.png` and the screenshot `assets/screenshots/2026-10-28-index.png`. Both are referenced by README.md but absent from `git ls-tree HEAD`; they exist only as ignored working-tree files, so a fresh clone renders broken images and the approved media cannot be committed.

The launcher is committed with mode 100644 (`git ls-tree HEAD play.sh`), so the README's documented `./play.sh` fails with 'Permission denied' on a fresh Linux/macOS clone. The shebang alone does not make it executable; commit it as 100755 or document `bash play.sh` instead.

The fallback interpreter path is stored unquoted (`%%~D` strips the quotes from the candidate) and later expanded unquoted at line 67. A Python installed under a profile or directory whose path contains a space is split into separate tokens, so the one-click launcher fails on those machines. Quote the stored path while keeping the existing `py -3` value working.
findings.patch_new: set "PYTHON_EXE="%%~D""

findings.message: `use_item` only handles potions and equipment and falls through to this generic refusal for scrolls. `scroll_fireball`, added in this commit and still dropped by necromancers and archers, has no use branch in the browser either (only `scroll_nova` was added later), so the mage's starting Scroll of Inferno and merchant copies are inert: selecting one and pressing Use silently does nothing and the i

When poison and burn are both active and the poison tick kills the monster, the burn block still runs on the corpse and calls _handleMonsterDefeat again at line 2180, awarding XP/gold, kill streak and bounty progress twice. On the boss this can also schedule two victory timeouts and duplicate the Crown. Skip burn once hp is already 0.

Casting Shield Wall assigns 4 unconditionally, overwriting the 25-turn Blessing of the Aegis granted by the shrine. The Python shield_wall uses Entity.apply_status, which keeps the longer duration, so the client silently cuts a stronger buff to 4 turns. Use Math.max.

Shadow Strike uses a hard-coded 70% crit instead of player.crit_chance. Class and gear crit from _recalculatePlayerStats is ignored, so ring_shadow (+15%) and boots_shadowstep (+10%) do nothing for the rogue's signature ability, while Python shadow_strike uses effective_crit_chance + 0.40.

Victory is delayed 1.5s and the callback has no gameOver/victory guard. If the player dies to poison, burn or remaining escorts in that window, handlePlayerDeath's death modal is replaced by victory. If the player steps on the stairs first, handleVictory already ran, so the timer runs it again and recordRunEnd counts the run twice.

saveGameState persists merchantStock at line 2445, but this resume branch never restores it. openMerchantShop sees an empty array and substitutes the built-in fallback, so a reloaded run's shop loses server-only stock such as the Aegis Tower Shield and the scrolls. Restore saved.merchantStock.

findings.message: The mage starts with scroll_fireball, but the client's useInventoryItem only has a branch for scroll_nova (static/js/engine.js:1992) and Python Player.use_item has no scroll branch at all. Selecting the starter scroll shows a Use button, but clicking it silently does nothing and the item cannot be consumed. Add a fireball-scroll handler or remove it from the kit and merchant stock.

stopMusic schedules a 1.1s timeout that reads this.musicNodes at fire time and then clears it. If the player toggles music off then on during that window, startMusic replaces musicNodes with the new nodes and the stale timeout stops/disconnects them and empties the array, leaving musicPlaying true but silent. Capture the old node array and only clear it if it is still current.

The Crown of Eternity is awarded only when the backpack has a free slot; at 12 items it is silently skipped, yet handleVictory always reports 'Relics Recovered: Crown of Eternity' at line 2423. Guarantee the boss relic or report that it was lost.

`recordMonsterDefeat` is called at the top of `_handleMonsterDefeat` (line 1484) before `this.killStreak += 1` (line 1506), so `highestStreak` stores the previous streak. A five-kill streak is shown as `x4` in the Hall of Records while it is active; if the streak cools down before the run ends, the record stays at 4. Record `this.killStreak + 1` or move the call after the increment.
